issues.description: Method signature mismatch for getTotalNumberOfStudents: The problem statement and UML declare a no-argument method "getTotalNumberOfStudents()" returning an int, but the solution implements "public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests)" (adds a boolean parameter). The template contains a TODO for implementing getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This parameter difference breaks the exercise API: automated tests or student code that expect the no-argument method will not match the solution implementation and may fail or cause confusion about the required signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the exercise API by adding the no-argument method "public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()" that returns the intended total number of students. If an option to include/exclude guest students is pedagogically desired, add an overloaded method "public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests)" in addition to the no-argument method, and update any tests or the problem statement/UML to document the overload if needed.
